FAQ

Quick answers.

How do I order in bulk?

Use the form above. It opens WhatsApp with your order ready to send, and we confirm price and delivery.

Do you deliver?

Yes, delivery is available for bulk orders within Ilorin. Tell us your location when you order.

Can my company open a fleet account?

Yes. Message us on WhatsApp with your company name and monthly volume and we’ll set up the terms.

How do I know today’s price?

It’s shown at the top of this page and updated whenever the pump price changes.

What payment methods do you accept?

Cash and bank transfer. Ask us about other options for fleet accounts.
